verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own EC&VC page says its core focus is investor fundraising "from seed and Series A through to larger institutional and growth rounds," including term sheets, valuation mechanics and investor rights. It also cites a representative deal: N26's billion-dollar funding round. missing for 10: quantified deal volume (only the qualitative "one of Europe's most active" claim), more than one representative equity-round case study, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages

citations.quote: Our core focus is on investor fundraising and related strategic transactions, from seed and Series A through to larger institutional and growth rounds. We advise on term sheets, valuation mechanics, investment structures, investor rights and governance
Osborne Clarke advised N26, a German direct bank, in a billion-dollar funding round with top investors including Third Point, Coatue and Dragoneer.
As one of Europe's most active venture capital legal teams
